question: For each IPL season, identify the top three batsmen with the highest total runs scored and the top three bowlers with the most wickets taken, excluding ‘run out’, ‘hit wicket’, and ‘retired hurt’ dismissals. In the event of ties in runs or wickets, break the tie using the smaller player ID. Then output these six players in matched positions—batsman 1 with bowler 1, batsman 2 with bowler 2, and batsman 3 with bowler 3—in ascending order of the season ID, along with each player’s total runs or wickets.
sql:
SELECT 
    tb.season_id,
    tb.rn AS position,
    tb.player_id AS batsman_id,
    CAST(tb.total_runs AS BIGINT) AS total_runs,
    tbr.player_name AS batsman_name,
    tb2.player_id AS bowler_id,
    CAST(tb2.total_wickets AS BIGINT) AS total_wickets,
    tb2r.player_name AS bowler_name
FROM (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, total_runs, rn
    FROM (
        SELECT m.season_id, bb.striker AS player_id, SUM(b.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(b.runs_scored) DESC, bb.striker ASC) AS rn
        FROM batsman_scored b
        JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id
        JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
        GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.striker
    )
    WHERE rn <= 3
) tb
JOIN (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, total_wickets, rn
    FROM (
        SELECT m.season_id, bb.bowler AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_wickets,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bb.bowler ASC) AS rn
        FROM wicket_taken w
        JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON w.match_id = bb.match_id AND w.over_id = bb.over_id AND w.ball_id = bb.ball_id
        JOIN match m ON w.match_id = m.match_id
        WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
        GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.bowler
    )
    WHERE rn <= 3
) tb2 ON tb.season_id = tb2.season_id AND tb.rn = tb2.rn
JOIN player tbr ON tb.player_id = tbr.player_id
JOIN player tb2r ON tb2.player_id = tb2r.player_id
ORDER BY tb.season_id, tb.rn
